questions.question: Which form defines an exponential function?
questions.explanation: An exponential function has the form $f(x)=ab^x$ with a fixed positive base $b>0$ and the variable in the exponent.
questions.source_support: Definition: functions $f(x) = ab^x$ are exponential functions, where $b \gt 0$ is the base.
